mapper.select: /*searchStockOne*/ SELECT STOCK_SEQ ,STOCK_ID ,STOCK_CODE ,STOCK_KO_NAME ,STOCK_EN_NAME ,STOCK_MARKET ,STOCK_TIMEZONE ,STOCK_SECTOR ,STOCK_DESC ,STOCK_URL ,STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE ,STOCK_TYPE ,STOCK_TYPE_SPECS ,STOCK_CURRENCY ,STOCK_ALIASES ,COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK WHERE STOCK_CODE = #{in_stockCode}

/*searchStocksKeyword*/ SELECT STOCK_SEQ ,STOCK_ID ,STOCK_CODE ,STOCK_KO_NAME ,STOCK_EN_NAME ,STOCK_MARKET ,STOCK_TIMEZONE ,STOCK_SECTOR ,STOCK_DESC ,STOCK_URL ,STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE ,STOCK_TYPE ,STOCK_TYPE_SPECS ,STOCK_CURRENCY ,STOCK_ALIASES ,COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK WHERE STOCK_CODE like '%' || #{in_stockCode} || '%' OR STOCK_KO_NAME like '%' || #{in_stockCode} || '%'

/*selectPortfolioStockList*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TSSP.STOCK_CODE ,(CASE WHEN TSIS.STOCK_MARKET ='kosdaq' THEN '#'||TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME ELSE TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME END)AS STOCK_KO_NAME ,TSIS.STOCK_URL ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL ,SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'BUY' THEN QUANTITY WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'SELL' THEN -QUANTITY ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_QUANTITY ,SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'BUY' THEN (PURCHASE_PRICE * QUANTITY) WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'SELL' THEN (-PURCHASE_PRICE * QUANTITY) ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE_PRICE ,(TO_CHAR(TSSA.MODIFY_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{groupMarket}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END ))) AS MODIFY_DATE FROM TB_S_STOCK_PORTFOLIO TSSP LEFT JOIN TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS ON TSSP.STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_ANALYSIS TSSA ON TSSP.STOCK_CODE = TSSA.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSSP.CLOSE_FLAG ='N' AND TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE= #{groupMarket} GROUP BY TSSP.STOCK_CODE, TSIS.STOCK_MARKET, TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME ,TSIS.STOCK_URL, TSSA.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL,TSSA.MODIFY_DATE ORDER BY TOTAL_QUANTITY DESC )A WHERE TOTAL_QUANTITY > 0

/*selectStockInfo*/ SELECT TSIS.STOCK_ID ,TSIS.STOCK_CODE ,(CASE WHEN TSIS.STOCK_MARKET ='kosdaq' THEN '#'||TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME ELSE TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME END)AS STOCK_KO_NAME ,TSIS.STOCK_MARKET ,TSIS.STOCK_URL ,TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE ,TSIS.STOCK_TYPE ,(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(STOCK_GROUP) FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST WHERE STOCK_GROUP = #{group_id} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stock_code}) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) STOCK_GROUP ,(SELECT STOCK_SMA5 ||',' || STOCK_SMA20 ||','|| STOCK_SMA60 ||','|| STOCK_SMA120 ||','|| STOCK_SMA240 FROM TB_S_STOCK_30MINANALYSIS WHERE STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE) AS STOCK_30MINSMA ,TSSA.STOCK_SMA5 ||',' || TSSA.STOCK_SMA20 ||','|| TSSA.STOCK_SMA60 ||','|| TSSA.STOCK_SMA120 ||','|| TSSA.STOCK_SMA240 as STOCK_SMA ,(SELECT STOCK_SMA60 FROM TB_S_STOCK_30MINANALYSIS WHERE STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE) AS STOCK_5BC ,TSSA.STOCK_MON ,TSSA.STOCK_SMA5_MON_PRICE ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_TIME ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS ,COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_ANALYSIS TSSA ON TSIS.STOCK_CODE = TSSA.STOCK_CODE WHERE TSIS.STOCK_CODE = #{stock_code}

/*selectStockMarket*/ SELECT TSIS.STOCK_ID, TSIS.STOCK_CODE, TSIS.STOCK_KO_NAME, TSIS.STOCK_MARKET, TSIS.STOCK_URL, TSIW.STOCK_SEQ, TSIW.STOCK_GROUP ,(SELECT STOCK_SMA5 ||',' || STOCK_SMA20 ||','|| STOCK_SMA60 ||','|| STOCK_SMA120 ||','|| STOCK_SMA240 FROM TB_S_STOCK_30MINANALYSIS WHERE STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE) AS STOCK_30MINSMA ,TSSA.STOCK_SMA5 ||',' || TSSA.STOCK_SMA20 ||','|| TSSA.STOCK_SMA60 ||','|| TSSA.STOCK_SMA120 ||','|| TSSA.STOCK_SMA240 as STOCK_SMA ,(SELECT STOCK_SMA60 FROM TB_S_STOCK_30MINANALYSIS WHERE STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE) AS STOCK_5BC ,TSSA.STOCK_MON ,TSSA.STOCK_SMA5_MON_PRICE ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_TIME ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_TIMEDAYS ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_SIGNAL ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKSIGNAL ,TSSA.STOCK_MACD_STREAKDAYS ,(TO_CHAR(TSSA.MODIFY_DATE, (CASE WHEN #{groupMarket}='KR' THEN 'YYYYMMDDHH24' ELSE 'YYYYMMDD' END ))) AS MODIFY_DATE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST TSIW LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_ANALYSIS TSSA ON TSSA.STOCK_CODE = TSIW.STOCK_CODE INNER JOIN TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK TSIS ON TSIW.STOCK_CODE = TSIS.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSIW.STOCK_GROUP = '0000' AND TSIS.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE =#{groupMarket} ORDER BY TSIW.STOCK_SEQ
mapper.insert: /*mergeInterestStock*/ MERGE INTO TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK T USING ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(STOCK_SEQ) + 1 END AS STOCK_SEQ, #{stock_id} AS STOCK_ID, #{stock_code} AS STOCK_CODE, #{stock_ko_name} AS STOCK_KO_NAME, #{stock_en_name} AS STOCK_EN_NAME, #{stock_market} AS STOCK_MARKET, #{stock_timezone} AS STOCK_TIMEZONE, #{stock_sector} AS STOCK_SECTOR, #{stock_desc} AS STOCK_DESC, #{stock_url} AS STOCK_URL, #{stock_country_code} AS STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, #{stock_type} AS STOCK_TYPE, #{stock_type_specs} AS STOCK_TYPE_SPECS, #{stock_currency} AS STOCK_CURRENCY, #{stock_aliases} AS STOCK_ALIASES FROM TB_S_INTEREST_STOCK ) S ON (T.STOCK_ID = S.STOCK_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.STOCK_CODE = S.STOCK_CODE, T.STOCK_KO_NAME = S.STOCK_KO_NAME, T.STOCK_EN_NAME = S.STOCK_EN_NAME, T.STOCK_MARKET = S.STOCK_MARKET, T.STOCK_TIMEZONE = S.STOCK_TIMEZONE, T.STOCK_SECTOR = S.STOCK_SECTOR, T.STOCK_DESC = S.STOCK_DESC, T.STOCK_URL = S.STOCK_URL, T.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE = S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, T.STOCK_TYPE = S.STOCK_TYPE, T.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS = S.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS, T.STOCK_CURRENCY = S.STOCK_CURRENCY, T.STOCK_ALIASES = S.STOCK_ALIASES WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STOCK_SEQ, STOCK_ID, STOCK_CODE, STOCK_KO_NAME, STOCK_EN_NAME, STOCK_MARKET, STOCK_TIMEZONE, STOCK_SECTOR, STOCK_DESC, STOCK_URL , STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, STOCK_TYPE, STOCK_TYPE_SPECS, STOCK_CURRENCY, STOCK_ALIASES) VALUES (S.STOCK_SEQ, S.STOCK_ID, S.STOCK_CODE, S.STOCK_KO_NAME, S.STOCK_EN_NAME, S.STOCK_MARKET, S.STOCK_TIMEZONE, S.STOCK_SECTOR, S.STOCK_DESC, S.STOCK_URL , S.STOCK_COUNTRY_CODE, S.STOCK_TYPE, S.STOCK_TYPE_SPECS, S.STOCK_CURRENCY, S.STOCK_ALIASES)

INSERT INTO TB_S_INTEREST_GROUP( GROUP_SEQ ,GROUP_ID ,GROUP_NAME ,GROUP_DESC ,GROUP_MARKET ,USE_FLAG ,CREATE_DATE )VALUES( (SELECT LPAD(CASE WHEN MAX(GROUP_SEQ) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(GROUP_SEQ) + 1 END, 4, '0') AS GROUP_SEQ FROM TB_S_INTEREST_GROUP) ,(SELECT LPAD(CASE WHEN MAX(GROUP_ID) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(GROUP_ID) + 1 END, 4, '0') AS GROUP_ID FROM TB_S_INTEREST_GROUP) ,#{group_name} ,#{group_name} ,#{groupMarket} ,'Y' ,SYSDATE )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST SELECT STOCK_SEQ ,STOCK_CODE ,(SELECT GROUP_ID FROM TB_S_INTEREST_GROUP WHERE GROUP_NAME =#{group_name}) AS STOCK_GROUP ,STOCK_GROUP_DIV ,STOCK_CLOSE ,STOCK_30MIN_SMA_LINES ,STOCK_SMA_LINES ,SYSDATE AS MODIFY_DATE ,SYSDATE AS CREATE_DATE FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST WHERE STOCK_GROUP =#{group_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST SELECT (SELECT (CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE MAX(STOCK_SEQ) + 1 END) FROM TB_S_INTEREST_WATCHLIST WHERE STOCK_GROUP = #{group_id}) AS STOCK_SEQ ,TSSA.STOCK_CODE ,#{group_id} AS STOCK_GROUP ,#{group_div} AS STOCK_GROUP_DIV ,TSSA.STOCK_CLOSE ,TSS3A.STOCK_SMA_LINES AS STOCK_30MIN_SMA_LINES ,TSSA.STOCK_SMA_LINES ,SYSDATE AS MODIFY_DATE ,SYSDATE AS CREATE_DATE FROM TB_S_STOCK_ANALYSIS TSSA LEFT JOIN TB_S_STOCK_30MINANALYSIS TSS3A ON TSSA.STOCK_CODE = TSS3A.STOCK_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND TSSA.STOCK_CODE =#{stock_code}
mapper.select: /*selectPriceCalculate*/ SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'BUY' THEN QUANTITY WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'SELL' THEN -QUANTITY ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_QUANTITY ,SUM(CASE WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'BUY' THEN (PURCHASE_PRICE * QUANTITY) WHEN TRANSACTION_TYPE = 'SELL' THEN (-PURCHASE_PRICE * QUANTITY) ELSE 0 END) AS TOTAL_PURCHASE_PRICE FROM TB_S_STOCK_PORTFOLIO WHERE STOCK_CODE =#{stock_code} AND CLOSE_FLAG ='N'

/*selectPriceHistory*/ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM( SELECT A.* ,ROWNUM AS RNUM FROM( SELECT STOCK_SEQ ,STOCK_GROUP ,STOCK_CODE ,PURCHASE_PRICE ,QUANTITY ,TRANSACTION_TYPE ,CLOSE_FLAG ,TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE ,COUNT(*) OVER() TOTAL_COUNT FROM TB_S_STOCK_PORTFOLIO WHERE 1=1 AND STOCK_CODE =#{stock_code} AND CLOSE_FLAG ='N' ORDER BY CREATE_DATE DESC, STOCK_SEQ DESC ) A ) WHERE RNUM <= ${totalPagesize} )WHERE RNUM > ${currentPageSize}

SELECT STOCK_SEQ ,STOCK_GROUP ,STOCK_CODE ,PURCHASE_PRICE ,TARGET_PRICE ,QUANTITY ,TRANSACTION_TYPE FROM TB_S_STOCK_PORTFOLIO WHERE STOCK_GROUP = #{group_id} AND STOCK_CODE = #{stock_code} ORDER BY STOCK_SEQ DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_S_STOCK_PORTFOLIO SET CLOSE_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE 1=1 AND STOCK_CODE = #{stock_code}
